run_reshard_fsdp_checkpoints: run the CLI to reshard FSDP checkpoints from sharded files into a single consolidated checkpoint
run_reshard_with_dtype: run reshard_fsdp_checkpoints with output_dtype bf16 to convert model weights to bfloat16 precision
run_reshard_skip_optimizer: run reshard_fsdp_checkpoints with skip_optimizer_state True to exclude optimizer states from the output
run_reshard_multiple_shards: run reshard_fsdp_checkpoints with num_output_shards 4 to split a checkpoint into four output shards
run_reshard_drop_metaseq: run reshard_fsdp_checkpoints with drop_metaseq_req True to strip metaseq-specific train_iterator state
